semiconductor_relevance: High — Shimifrez Inc. provides critical materials and components used in semiconductor manufacturing processes, including mask making and lead frame taping systems.
summary: Shimifrez Inc. specializes in precision metal fabrication, photo etching, and electro-forming, providing thin metal parts and consumable components essential for semiconductor manufacturing. Their expertise supports microelectronics projects from R&D to production, with consistent tooling and processes for both prototype and production parts.
